intents.answer: The semester examination dates are available in the academic calendar.

patterns: Where can I get the exam timetable?
When will the timetable be released?
intents.answer: The exam timetable is published on the college website and notice board about 3 weeks before the exams.

patterns: How can I download my hall ticket?
Where do I get the admit card?
Hall ticket not showing in portal
intents.answer: Log in to the student portal and download your hall ticket from the Examinations section. If it is missing, contact the examination office.

patterns: What is the minimum attendance for exams?
Am I eligible for exam with low attendance?
intents.answer: You need at least 75% attendance to be eligible for the semester exams.

patterns: Minimum marks to pass a subject
How many marks are needed to pass?
intents.answer: You need at least 40% in the semester exam and 50% overall (internal + external) to pass a subject.

patterns: When will the results be published?
How do I check my exam result?
Where can I see my marks?
intents.answer: Results are usually published within 30 days after the last exam on the student portal.

patterns: How do I apply for revaluation?
I want to recheck my answer paper
intents.answer: Apply through the student portal within 7 days of result publication and pay the revaluation fee.

patterns: How do I apply for arrear exams?
I failed a subject, what should I do?
intents.answer: Register for arrear exams on the student portal before the last date given in the exam notification.

patterns: How do I pay the exam fee?
Last date to pay exam fee
intents.answer: The exam fee is paid online through the student portal before the exam form deadline. A late fee applies after the deadline.
Internal marks are based on two internal tests, assignments and attendance.

patterns: What can I carry into the exam hall?
Are mobile phones allowed in the exam?
intents.answer: Only your hall ticket, college ID card, pen and an approved calculator are allowed. Mobile phones and smartwatches are not allowed.

patterns: I missed my exam due to illness
What if I miss an exam?
intents.answer: Submit a medical certificate to the Controller of Examinations within 3 days to apply for a re-exam.

patterns: How can I get my mark sheet?
Where do I collect my marksheet?
intents.answer: Apply at the examination office or through the student portal. Mark sheets are issued after results are published.

patterns: What is the punishment for cheating in exams?
What happens if I copy in the exam?
intents.answer: Malpractice can lead to cancellation of the exam and a ban from further exams, as decided by the disciplinary committee.
Practical exams are held before the theory exams. The dates are given in the exam timetable.
The examination office is in the administrative block and is open from 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM on working days.

patterns: How can I apply for a bonafide certificate?
intents.answer: You can apply through the student portal or contact the academic office.
The library is open from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM on working days.
